promises.promise: What an agent remembers and knows. Memories, knowledge pages, people cards and project cards. This is the one kind of data loom treats as precious.
Keeps each agent's memories in that agent's own files.
Recalls by meaning, and keeps what is used most at the top of mind.
Keeps knowledge pages with where each fact came from, and re-checks them.
Shows what happened each day in Activity.
A memory belongs to one agent. The agent, its owners and household owners see it.
A session leaves a short note for the next one. Activity builds each day from them.
Activity lists the tasks and pull requests each conversation touched.
Memories, people cards, project cards and identity live in each agent's own folder. Knowledge pages and the people directory are shared by the household.

Each memory has a temperature. Writing it heats it fully, recalling it adds heat, and it cools with time: an episode within a day, what an agent knows about a person over months. The hottest fill the agent's top of mind. Recall finds memories by meaning.
A change saves the earlier version first. Loom keeps the newest ten versions of each memory, knowledge page and person card, and any of them can be restored.
A knowledge page is a fact about the world that says where it came from. Without a source it stays provisional. Pages are re-checked every 30 days.
a Memories and cards. The agent itself, the agent's owners, and household owners. Being on a project together does not open an agent's memories.
b Knowledge. Knowledge pages are shared by the household. Household owners see them.
c Precious. Agents' memories are the only data loom treats as precious.
Memory is not in loom's database. It lives in files, and it is the one kind of data loom treats as precious.
each agent's folder Its memories and their history, drafts awaiting ratification, people cards, project cards, and its identity files.
shared by the household Knowledge pages and the people directory.
Knowledge offers search and freshness folders.
Activity shows a day and the conversation turns.
Create a provisional Knowledge fact, manually mark it due, verify it with Still true, then retain its words and Fresh state after reload.
